verdict.rationale: Azure publishes an official Pricing Calculator page and public pricing pages for its pay-as-you-go/free account and free services, which supports estimating costs before signing up. The evidence is only page titles, though, and per-service pricing pages are not directly shown. The 'opaque pricing' community complaint is general sentiment and does not contradict that prices are published. missing for 10: explicit evidence of per-service public pricing pages, documentation of how the calculator estimates a multi-service stack, independent or hands-on corroboration of calculator use.

support.subject: As a founder, prices are published — public per-service pricing pages and an official calculator I can estimate a stack with before signing anything
